function: Downlink CSI acquisition (channel estimation from sparse pilots): HMP initial estimate in angle-delay domain refined by attention network ADCRN, then 2D-FT to space-frequency channel. p. 1, p. 3
system: FDD MIMO-OFDM downlink; BS UPA 32 antennas (8x2), UE ULA 4 antennas, 1024 subcarriers; no RIS; carrier frequency not stated. p. 2, Table I p. 4
method: Hybrid: HMP message passing (model-driven) then attention network ADCRN (angle and delay attention modules), supervised with model-based 2D-FT loss, Adam; fine-tuning for new pilot density. p. 3-6
data_channel: Public CAICT/OPPO dataset [27] with 3GPP TR 38.901 UMa LOS/NLOS channels: 300,000 samples, 210,000 train, 30,000 validation, 60,000 test, SNR -5 to 25 dB. p. 4
test_conditions: Mixed-SNR training at a pilot density (Np 4, 5, 6); test on held-out split over SNR, and at other pilot densities directly or after 15 retraining epochs. p. 4-6
baselines: Non-learned: LS+LCI, AMP+LCI, LMMSE+FT, VAMP+FT, HMP+FT. Learned: LS+CNN [14], AMP+DCNN [17], DACEN+FT [16]. p. 4-5
metrics: Space-frequency domain NMSE in dB versus pilot density and SNR (Fig. 4); power delay profile visualization (Fig. 5); NMSE after retraining (Table II). p. 5-6
complexity: Big-O orders of HMP, angle attention, delay attention, and 2D-FT stated; no parameter count or runtime. p. 4
openness: none released by the authors; trains on public dataset [27], https://www.mobileai-dataset.cn. p. 4, p. 6
q1_support: p. 4: "the channel model is the urban-macrocell (UMa) model defined in the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) standard [28]"
q2_support: p. 6: "the ADHMD trained at Np = 5 and tested at Np = 4"
q3_support: p. 5: "outperforms DANCE+FT, LS+CNN, AMP+DCNN, and HMP+FT with improvements of 0.53 dB, 0.71 dB, 0.78 dB, and 1.12 dB"
q4_support: p. 4: "the computational complexities of HMP, AAM, DAM, and 2D-FT are O(F Np NT Nd NRx NTx)"
q5_support: p. 4: "We consider a publicly available dataset [27] in our experiments"
notes: Included, area 2: downlink CSI acquisition, that is channel estimation, in FDD massive MIMO (p. 1). Table I (p. 4) and Table II (p. 6) were read from the page images. q1: the dataset [27] uses the 3GPP TR 38.901 UMa model (Table I p. 4 lists 38.901 UMa NLOS/LOS; reference [28] on p. 6 is TR 38.901 V16.1.0). q2: Table II (p. 6) gives ADHMD trained at one pilot density and tested at another, and ADHMD-F with 15 retraining epochs against 300 training epochs; the SNR sweep is not counted. q3: non-learned LS+LCI, AMP+LCI, LMMSE+FT, VAMP+FT and HMP+FT; earlier learned LS+CNN [14], AMP+DCNN [17] and DACEN+FT [16] (typed DANCE+FT in the text), all compared on NMSE (Fig. 4, p. 5); HMP+FT is also the ablation without ADCRN but is a published non-learned algorithm [10] and is not used as the learned baseline. q4: only Big-O orders, no parameter count or runtime. q5: public dataset of channels [27] with link https://www.mobileai-dataset.cn (p. 6); the paper gives no code link of its own. No RIS in the system model (p. 2). Carrier frequency is not stated.
